children: United Community Banks completed a strategic balance sheet repositioning after the $2.0B Navitas sale and expects a ~$300M pre-tax repositioning loss while boosting liquidity and repurchase capacity.
Sold ~$2.6B of lower-yielding securities (2.20% yield, ~5.5yr duration) and reclassified $2.2B HTM to AFS to reduce interest rate risk.
Net proceeds (~$4.2B including Navitas) initially redeployed into cash and short-duration securities yielding ~4.5% (avg duration ~2 years).
Company expects an estimated pre-tax loss of ~ $300M from the repositioning, partially offset by a $64M pre-tax Navitas gain; Q3 net loss expected.
Proforma CET1 remains strong (~14.5% after Navitas; projected >13% after repositioning and Peach State acquisition).
Board authorized an incremental $100M buyback through 2027 (outstanding authorization now $113M); $87M repurchased YTD including $50M in 3Q26.
